utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll put you down for Saturday out front, and we can sort the tools when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, I’ll be there Saturday on the front porch and we can sort the tools then. If I think of anyone handy, I’ll send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren — I appreciate it. If you hear from anyone handy, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Mina — I’ll keep an ear out and send any handy folks your way. I may need a reminder about Saturday, but I’ve got it in mind.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Pia, I’m organizing the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, and I could really use a few helpers. Would you be able to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’ll need the exact time and what supplies you still need so I can make sure everything’s covered.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still lining up helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, so if you know anyone handy, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help, and I’ll send anyone handy your way too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time should I come by the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Come by around 10 on Saturday if that works—I'm still lining up a few handy helpers too. If you know anyone who can pitch in, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Tess is still lining up helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. If you know anyone handy, send them her way.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can help out Saturday. I’ll send anyone handy I know Tess’s way too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Rosa, I think I can help with the repair drive on Saturday. Just remind me what time you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — I’d be grateful. If you can be there around 9 in the morning, that would help a lot.
